Combining SPZ-quantized 3D Gaussian Splatting (for photorealistic captured environments) with Draco/KTX2 GLTF PBR meshes (for articulated CAD parts and shader swaps)
Sharing WebGPU/WebGL hardware Z-depth buffers and Spherical Harmonics (SH) light probes between 3DGS backdrops and PBR hero assets
not_for: Plain 2D text blogs with no 3D product assets
